final: WITH totals AS (SELECT p.player_id, p.death_country, SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) AS total FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE a.g_1b IS NOT NULL AND a.g_cf IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.player_id, p.death_country), mean AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS average_total FROM totals) SELECT SUM(t.total), AVG(t.total - m.average_total) FROM totals AS t CROSS JOIN mean AS m WHERE t.total > m.average_total
